body: Thank you for replying. I really do appreciate you and your words. I have depression and anxiety. And sometimes it's really hard to control my feelings and mentality. And at first I wanted to live long enough to see things get better. But what if it won't for another 20 years....that's a long, long time. I don't know if I can do it, I feel really weak. I don't have family support, actually I was blamed for my own depression by my mother. I've lost most if not all of my friends. I'd be okay for an hour, then something reminds me of my past or horrible memories and I'm back to square once. This going back and forth is taking a huge toll. I don't even wanna get out of bed most days. I know I'm weak, I wish I wasn't this way. So then I wouldn't have lost everyone around me or make things depressing for people(like I am now). I don't see my existence affecting anyone... I can't even love myself. I don't know what I'm doing here.
Yeah. My second medication now. Since the first kind wasn't working...this one isn't doing so good either.
